specs.alt: A huge room full of floating grey static squares with one thin glowing ribbon sheet curving through it; recognizable little picture-cards rest on the sheet while all the static drifts off it, illustrating the manifold hypothesis that real images concentrate on a thin low-dimensional surface inside a vast noisy pixel space.
specs.caption: Almost every arrangement of pixels is static; real photographs huddle on a vanishingly thin sheet, and learning that sheet is the whole job of a generative model.

specs.anchorText: Picture the five families as houseguests asked to draw the same cat.
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm, soft color palette on a clean white background with generous margins: five distinct friendly cartoon characters seated around a cozy table, each drawing the same cat in their own comical way, arranged left to right. Character one (the flow) carefully draws a road that loops out and back, walking it backwards. Character two (the autoregressive) reads from a long unrolling scroll and inks the cat one tiny square at a time, very slowly, like a patient diarist. Character three (the GAN) paints boldly while a tiny stern art-critic character peers over its shoulder judging it. Character four (the VAE) squints, shrugs amiably, and holds up a slightly soft, blurry cat saying 'close enough' in spirit. Character five (the diffusion model) gestures proudly at a little snowstorm of dots that is clearing to reveal a sharp cat. All five end up with a recognizable cat. Friendly approachable comic-strip or XKCD-inspired style, expressive characters, minimal clutter, suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle humor in their wildly different methods reaching the same goal. Keep the composition clear, five characters, one shared cat, different routes.
specs.alt: Five friendly cartoon characters around a table each drawing the same cat differently: one walks a reversible road, one inks pixel by pixel from a scroll, one paints under an art critic's gaze, one shrugs and holds a soft blurry cat, and one clears a snowstorm of dots into a sharp cat, illustrating the five generative families VAE, GAN, flow, autoregressive, and diffusion taking different routes to the same sample.
specs.caption: Five families, five wildly different routes to the same picture: invert, chain, contest, compress, and denoise; the trilemma is just the bill each one hands you on the way out.

specs.alt: A cartoon control panel where a few icon-labeled sliders feed a bulky decoder machine that outputs a portrait; a designer nudges the smile slider and the decoded face gains a wider grin, illustrating a low-dimensional latent code, the decoder that carries the complexity, and editing an attribute by adding a direction in latent space.
specs.caption: A few hundred numbers hold a whole face: the decoder handles the boring parts everyone shares, and nudging one latent direction slides a single attribute like adding a smile.

specs.anchorText: I drew them two of the three on a napkin and said pick.
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm, soft color palette on a clean white background with generous margins: a friendly cartoon generative-model character holding up a paper napkin with a triangle drawn on it, each corner marked by a simple icon (a sparkle for fidelity, a fan of varied little faces for diversity, a stopwatch for speed). The character can only press two corner-icons glowing at once, while the third corner stays dim, with a slightly apologetic shrug. Around it, two small gently-comic failure vignettes float: one shows crisp beautiful faces that are all nearly identical (high quality, low diversity, the mode-collapse failure), the other shows a varied but soft, slightly blurry set of faces (high diversity, soft quality). A customer character flips the napkin over hopefully looking for a nonexistent fourth corner. Friendly approachable comic-strip or XKCD-inspired style, expressive, minimal clutter, suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image (icons only). Gentle humor: there is no fourth corner. Keep it focused on one clear metaphor: pick two of fidelity, diversity, and speed.
specs.alt: A cartoon generative model holds a napkin with a triangle whose corners are a sparkle, a fan of varied faces, and a stopwatch; only two corners glow while the third stays dim, flanked by two failure vignettes of identical crisp faces and varied blurry faces, illustrating the quality-diversity-speed trilemma where improving any two costs the third.
specs.caption: Beautiful, varied, and instant: you get to keep two, and the napkin never grows a fourth corner no matter how many times you turn it over.
